title: A novel horizontal-flow biofilter with polyurethane foam for decentralised post-treatment of UASB reactor effluent treating municipal wastewater
content:
Environ. Sci.: Water Res. Technol., 2026, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D6EW00249H, Paper
